degradation drill (shim off PATH).
01-busy: active turn — "✽ Composing… (9s · thinking with xhigh effort)".
This CLI version dropped the "(esc to interrupt)" hint; the active line is
"<spinner> <Verb>… (Ns · …)" and the finished line is past-tense with no
parens ("✻ Cooked for 36s"), so "… (" distinguishes busy. Older versions
keep "esc to interrupt" — the classifier matches either.
